# Special Library

Six original transparent PNG assets created using the built-in image-generation tool on October 1, 2026. Runtime rendering uses these bundled assets with no AI API calls. They are pre-rendered 3D-style illustrations, not meshes or poseable rigs.

The six designed pairs are thinking + crown, happy + snowflake, heart + fire, happy + heart, crying + rain, and angry + fire. Element aliases are declared in special.js. The existing planner keeps the dominant subject and all catalog emojis remain usable as additional ingredients. Extra elements use shared effects; other extras use accents. Unsupported pairs keep the standard Unicode renderer. Signature art can be switched off on the web.

Alpha bounds are measured once at load for consistent sizing. Loading failures resolve to standard rendering after at most 12 seconds. PNG and GIF exports wait for the selected artwork. Motion is gentle whole-character movement; it does not independently animate facial features or flames.
